name: (1R,2R,4R)-rel-1,7,7-Trimethylbicyclo[2.2.1]heptan-2-yl acrylate
storage_note: Keep in dark place, sealed in dry, room temperature
problems: Label also prints Formula C13H20O2, MW 208.3. H-code numbers in the small left-hand precautionary column were not legible (only P-codes P280/P305/P351/P338 partially readable), so hazard_codes_on_label left empty.

name: 2-Ethylhexyl acrylate
purity: 98%, contains >=0.001-<=0.11% monomethyl ether hydroquinone as stabilizer
problems: No CAS number and no lot/batch number appeared on any visible part of the label; the top panel that would carry the lot was only seen upside-down and out of focus, so cas and lot left blank. Label also prints the synonym '(+/-)-Acrylic acid 2-ethylhexyl ester'. Hazard statements are printed as EN/DE prose without H-codes.

name: SR368
problems: CAS 40220-08-4 is printed in the 'Contains:' line for Tris(2-hydroxyethyl)isocyanurate triacrylate, not as a product CAS; checksum verifies. Also printed: SAP ID 66477, NetWt 1.000 LB / (0.45 KG), GrossWt 2.000 LB, DOT Info: Not Regulated. No handwriting on this bottle. Hazard statements printed as prose without H-codes.

name: CN968C
problems: Proprietary blend, no CAS on label. 'Contains:' line reads >= 30 - < 50% Acrylic tetraester (Proprietary); >= 30 - < 60% Aliphatic urethane acrylate (Proprietary); >= 10 - < 30% Other acrylic esters (Proprietary). Also printed: SAP ID 80454, NetWt 1.000 LB / (0.45 KG), GrossWt 2.000 LB, DOT Info: Not Regulated. No handwriting on this bottle.

name: 2-(Diethylamino)ethyl methacrylate
problems: Label also prints Formula C10H19NO2, MW 185.26. The H-code digits in the tiny left column were soft in every frame; the accompanying statements ('CAUSES SKIN IRRITATION', 'MAY CAUSE AN ALLERGIC SKIN REACTION', 'CAUSES SERIOUS EYE IRRITATION', 'HARMFUL IF INHALED') were fully legible and map unambiguously to H315/H317/H319/H332.

name: Dibutyl Sebacate
problems: Label also prints C18H34O4, MW=314.47, SG=0.94, EC No. 203-672-5. In the handwriting 'Received May 2026' the year appears written over a scribbled-out earlier year; '2026' itself is clear. physical_state inferred from the printed specific gravity and the visibly liquid contents. Hazard statements printed as multilingual prose without H-codes.

name: Tetraethylene Glycol Dimethyl Ether
storage_note: Store under Ar. Air Sensitive. Hygroscopic
problems: Bottle straddles the 180 s boundary (handled ~174-182, most of it before 180); reported here. Lot read as 4A6OM-FZ but the 4th character is an O/0 ambiguity (reads as a wide oval, letter O) - flagged rather than guessed. The GHS pictogram panel sits to the left of the 'Danger Gevaar Gefahr' line and was never rotated into view, so pictograms left empty even though a signal word of Danger and reproductive-toxicity wording ('may damage fertility or the unborn child') are printed. Also printed: C10H22O5, MW=222.28, SG=1.01, EC No. 205-594-7, synonym 2,5,8,11,14-Pentaoxapentadecane. physical_state from the printed Japanese 'water-soluble liquid' plus SG.
